subject.title: feat(cron): per-job dynamic cadence (pacing + clamped next_check)

question: Should OpenClaw add the persisted `pacing` and `next_check` cron contract now as stage 1 of the open cron-unification proposal, after the scheduling invariants are repaired?
rationale: This changes the public gateway, CLI, tool, documentation, and persisted-job contract; the linked umbrella proposal remains open with an explicit maintainer product-decision signal.

options.title: Sponsor bounded stage 1
options.body: Keep the feature, fix the three scheduling regressions, require focused upgrade and real-runtime proof, then review the public contract as a bounded first stage.

options.title: Hold for umbrella design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide the complete heartbeat/cron unification boundary and its supported long-term API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded stage 1
recommendation.body: Keep the feature, fix the three scheduling regressions, require focused upgrade and real-runtime proof, then review the public contract as a bounded first stage.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the proposed stage and the linked umbrella design, so they are the clearest available person to clarify intended semantics for maintainer review.
